notes (optional):
- `extension.ts` `refuseNonSpecialistWorkflow`: a call with `script` plus `name` passes, because only `scriptPath` or a `name` without `script` is refused. The Claude hook rejects any key outside `{script,args}`. Whether the package prefers `name` over `script` is unverified, since `@tintinweb/pi-subagents` is not installed here. Refusing `name` always would be cheap. Contrived, so not a blocker.
- `extension.ts` `gather`: `taken.disabled` is overwritten by every collection. A later collection that fails or times out yields a notice-only result, which turns the gates back on in a project with `pi.enable` off. This needs a transient failure, so it is narrow. Only a collection that actually read the config should change the flag.
- `disabled` starts false, so the gates apply until the first collection settles. This fails closed and lasts only for startup.
- Rejected: `notAssignmentIds` wording. The existing code already puts "missing" entries there with `label: id` (`report.ts:434`), and the new entry follows that, with a test.
- Rejected: `PLUGIN_NAMESPACE` duplicate. It is commented, and a test pins it to the same value.
- Rejected: the handler now returns a Promise for every `tool_call`. Negligible cost, and the same one-line dispatch-first change would fix it if wanted.
- Not verifiable here: whether codemode-routed `SubagentWorkflow` calls raise `tool_call`. I could only read the code, and ran no Pi or live model.
